title: Ticket 1.61.10 — اولویت کد پرسنلی و ثبت دستی سفارش‌دهندگان (R17)
notes: Builds on R16. Makes an employee code entered for a domain user authoritative and safely merges the uniquely matching food/local personnel account, including legacy local accounts whose code exists only in username; creates a users backup and transfers references in the same transaction as the settings update. The manual attendance list and both save modes now require an active lunch order for today, using the ticket engine's internal order map and failing closed if order data is unavailable. Code-only update: no production accounts or data were changed and no database migration is required.
